title: Chicken Alfredo
description: Seared, herb-seasoned chicken over fettuccine in a from-scratch Alfredo sauce made with butter, garlic, cream and plenty of Parmesan.

steps.heading: Season
steps.text: Season the chicken on both sides with the basil and oregano, then sprinkle with the salt and pepper.

steps.heading: Boil the Pasta
steps.text: Cook the fettuccine in a pot of boiling salted water.

steps.heading: Sear the Chicken
steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a skillet, add the chicken and cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until it reaches 165°F. Set aside on a plate.

steps.heading: Make the Sauce
steps.text: Melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Whisk in the flour and let it turn golden, about 1 minute more. Slowly whisk in the cream and milk and simmer to thicken.

steps.heading: Finish
steps.text: Whisk in the Parmesan until melted, then serve over the pasta with the chicken.
